info.description: Order engine, KDS, payments and sync for restaurant kiosks. All money values are integer LKR cents.

post.description:
One login for our team and restaurant owners / managers. `kind` says which console opens:
"installer" (Platform) or "admin" (Owner app). Team accounts may answer `{"need": "otp"}`
(send again with the phone code) or `{"need": "setup", ...}` (turn on 2-step first).

post.description:
Exchange a 6-digit pairing code (shown in the admin portal) for a device token.

The token is returned once. Only its hash is stored. Wrong codes are limited per address.

post.description:
Sign a device in with its restaurant's address + its screen code (like Square device codes).

The device gets its own key and stays signed in. A code only works at its own restaurant, for
its own screen. Signing in on another device signs the previous one out. Wrong codes are
rate-limited per network address.

get.description: One row per order, for accounting.

One row per invoice with every tax and charge in its own column (service charge, VAT, SSCL...).

Invoices are never edited after payment; refunds appear as their own columns. The column layout
is a clean base for RAMIS returns; confirm the exact upload format with your tax adviser.
What each payment method should add up to for a business day, and anything that needs a look.

schema.title: Response Reconciliation V1 Admin Venues  Venue Id  Reports Reconciliation Get

post.description:
Match the bank / gateway settlement file against our LankaQR and card-terminal payments.

Returns matched rows, amount mismatches, payments the bank does not have, and bank rows we
don't know. Cash and manually keyed card payments are not in a settlement file.
